Governance practitioners must design internal structures ... Contemplative practitioners and trauma-informed researchers need a place ... Legal counsel must give durable form ... findings.diagnosis: This is the clearest instance in the corpus of the counter-pattern to R-CAUTIOUS-HALF. Every one of the five sentences moved from describing a gap to issuing an instruction. It requires technical builders is a confession that the project has none. Technical builders must develop is a directive to strangers, in the most self-critical section of the book, from a project that has just said it has no public version operating. The pass that removed inner-state claims about readers elsewhere in this volume installed the imperative mood here, which shows it was not applying a single doctrine about reader autonomy. It was flattening whatever construction repeated, and the mood the flattening produced depended on the surrounding grammar rather than on any position about the reader.

openQuestions.question: Should the heading remain What Providence Actually Is Today?
openQuestions.context: The baseline heading is On the State of the Project, which matches its three siblings in this chapter, On the Form, On the Conversation, and On Releasing the Book Now. The pass renamed all four and broke the set. This section's heading is the one that changed most in kind: the others still name a subject, while What Providence Actually Is Today promises a present-tense answer in a section whose content is a list of things that do not exist. Not changed here; the label is a route.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required, and two results matter. This is the first section in the Volume II re-render where the ledger blocked a restoration rather than merely being consulted, which is the working proof that the search is worth its cost. And F1 settles a question the hypothesis under test raised. The pass was not applying a doctrine about how much the book should commit to. Confronted with five identical It requires clauses it flattened them, and the mood that flattening produced happened to be imperative, in the one section of the book that had least standing to give instructions. The pattern is mechanical, not editorial, which is why its effects point in opposite directions in different sections.
